messages:
sam: Heads-up — DB migration + dual-write backfill scheduled tonight 23:30 UTC. Primary goals: schema add 'user_flags' (non-null default), run streaming backfill, validate reads, and ensure rollback path. Who's taking owner for the deploy and smoke?
priya: I can own deploy + smoke. I'll be on call from 23:15–00:45 UTC.
mike: I can run the backfill job and watch perf metrics. Will be available for rollback if needed.
lina: I'll monitor the svc health dashboards and the canary traffic shift.
sam: Awesome. Priya — can you confirm the exact commands + smoke checklist here so I can hand off to on-call if needed? :eyes: 
priya: Copy. Deploy steps (summary):
```
1) set feature flag off (api-flags: user_flags_new = false)
2) apply migration: ./infra/migrations/run_migration --file add_user_flags.sql --timeout 30m
3) start dualwrite: services/dualwrite start --mode dry-run (10m) -> then live
4) kick backfill: jobs/backfill_user_flags --batch 1000 --checkpoint s3://redwood-backfill/checks
5) canary shift 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m windows
```
Smoke checklist: DB schema visible in pg: 
- `SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' AND column_name='user_flags';`
- basic reads/writes for sample users (create/update)
- tail app logs for errors: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=15m`
- check 95p latency < 200ms and error rate < 0.5%

mike: For the backfill, I'll watch CPU/GPU(?) — basically worker CPU and DB CPU. If write latency spikes >2x baseline for 5m, pause & revert.
priya: Rollback plan:
- cancel backfill job, revert dualwrite to primary-only (`services/dualwrite stop`)
- rollback migration if necessary using migration rollback script (has been smoke-tested in staging)
- if data drift detected, run compensating backfill using snapshots from before window

sam: devops-bot, post runbook link and create a temporary #incidents-private thread if we need to escalate?
devops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-migrations. Temporary incident channel will be created if any deploy step fails and you run `/escalate`.
lina: Small note — traffic window is quiet for EU peak, but APAC has scheduled maintenance earlier; double-checked with infra. Should be safe.
priya: I'll start with a dry-run at 23:20 UTC in staging to warm caches. Then production at 23:30. If everyone is ready, I'll ping 5m before start.
mike: Ready. I'll post resource snapshots every 10m during backfill.
sam: Great — thanks all. I'll be on standby and reachable. If anything goes sideways, call and also paste in thread. :thumbsup:
priya: 23:25 ping incoming, prepping console.
(23:50) pr iya: smoke pass at 23:47 — canary at 5% -> stable at 23:58. No errors so far. :white_check_mark:
(23:59) mike: backfill progress 44% checkpoint OK, CPU steady.
(00:25) lina: final canary 100% complete, latency within target, closing monitoring loop.
(00:27) pr iya: shutting down dualwrite dry-run flags off and confirming postdeploy checks passed.
(00:40) sam: Thanks team. Leaving notes in runbook and closing this thread.
